ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels restricted to the trailing edge boundary and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous white region; thin black pigmentation banding along the trailing edge; localized dark circular pixel clusters positioned near the peduncle junction and lower-medial areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree interior angle; vertical depth exceeds horizontal width at the opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; high-frequency jagged edges along the medial trailing edge transitioning to more pronounced, larger-amplitude protrusions towards the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sigmoidal trajectory; initial convexity from the notch center transitioning into a distinct concave sweep towards the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of dark circular clusters concentrated at the peduncle base and scattered across the interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent tan-colored hook-shaped linear mark on the right lobe; faint horizontal and diagonal scratches visible on the upper surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive hook-shaped tan pigmentation or scar on the right lobe; dark circular marks near the fluke center possibly indicating parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique tan-colored 'h-shaped' or hook-shaped marking on the right lobe surface.
